Body.Content:
What and why

We have restored the Send Availability feature to the Microsoft Outlook mobile app experience. When composing a reply to an email, users can tap the calendar icon and select Send Availability, which allows them to see their availability and easily list time slots for their recipients. iOS users also have access to this feature through the on-screen keyboard and VoiceOver. This change makes it easier for mobile users to schedule meetings with others.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): This update is available now.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Outlook for Android and iOS users

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Outlook for Android
  • Microsoft Outlook for iOS

What will happen

  • Users can view and send their meeting availability directly within the Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS mobile apps, making it easier to schedule meetings with others.
  • iOS users can also access this feature by using the on-screen keyboard or VoiceOver.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

Learn more

  • How do I send my availability to someone via email? | Microsoft Support

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
